citations.text_span: Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost.

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G04 states: "Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost." and separately flags "Coupon Memory Applicable". The booking record carries coupon_memory = False, which would treat missed coupons as permanently forgone rather than recoverable at a later observation. Please confirm the memory/catch-up feature applies as documented and authorise correction of coupon_memory to True, or identify the amendment or side letter that disapplies it.
triage.cited_clause: Memory feature: if a Coupon is not paid on a Coupon Payment Date because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied, that Coupon is not lost.
